nouvelAn.setupTitre: The year in review for two
nouvelAn.setupDesc: Four rounds to look back on your year: your memories, the year's awards, what you'll keep from it and what you want for the next one. One phone, sitting between the two of you.
nouvelAn.longueurTitre: How much time do you have?
nouvelAn.mancheDesc_souvenirs: Go back through the year together: the best moments, the laughs, the rough patches too. Open the photo gallery on your phone, it helps a lot!
nouvelAn.mancheDesc_trophees: For each award, agree on who deserves it, then tap their name. And if you both deserve it just as much, there's “Both of us”.
nouvelAn.manche_retenir: What we'll keep from this year
nouvelAn.mancheDesc_retenir: Slightly more serious questions, about what the year taught you about each other. Take your time, it's often the round people remember most.
nouvelAn.mancheDesc_avenir: Things you want to do, plans, places to go... And at the end, your couple's resolution for {{suivante}}.
nouvelAn.consigne: Take turns answering, then move on to the next card.
nouvelAn.tropheeConsigne: Agree on it, then tap the winner's name.
nouvelAn.resolutionTexte: Just one, written together. It will show in your year in review, and this phone will keep it for next year.
nouvelAn.resolutionExemple: For example: a weekend just for the two of us every three months
nouvelAn.aucunTrophee: Not this time... next year's your year!
nouvelAn.finVoeux: Happy New Year to you both!
nouvelAn.finGarde: This year in review stays on this phone. Come back here next year and you'll find your resolution.
nouvelAn.dejaTexte: It's saved on this phone, with your awards and your resolution.
nouvelAn.capsuleTexte: Last year, on this phone, you made this resolution for {{suivante}}:
